operative-knife-upgrades.head: 03590c7cd358a9c41ecab226b91a228c380852f5
operative-knife-upgrades.scope: Stock 1120 displayed +4 Thrown Damage, +15 Thrown Accuracy and +10% Combat Evasion. The pre-cast baseline came from the same fixture character in PR340. Stock 1121 replaced 1120 and displayed +6 Thrown Damage, +18 Thrown Accuracy and +10% Combat Evasion. The replacement removed the previous source.

operative-shifty-evasion.head: 03590c7cd358a9c41ecab226b91a228c380852f5
operative-shifty-evasion.scope: The stock hotbar action raised Combat Evasion from +10% to +90% while both thrown inputs remained unchanged. Combat Evasion returned to +10% at the 30-second expiry.
